FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key

calls.statement:
WITH wd AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.login_state, o.member_key AS o_member, o.status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, wd.login_state,
  (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_member, (wd.o_member IS NOT NULL) AS order_member,
  (dm.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS member_found,
  COUNT(*) lines, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dispatch_date
LEFT JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key=f.member_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

calls.statement:
SELECT MIN(o.order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) mx, MIN(f.sale_date) smin, MAX(f.sale_date) smax, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l2,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) orders, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) order_member_missing_in_dim,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cc
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key=o.member_key
WHERE f.member_key IS NULL AND o.login_state='logged_in'

SELECT COUNT(*) orders, SUM(CASE WHEN f.m IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lines_member_null, SUM(CASE WHEN f.mm = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mixed
FROM (SELECT o.web_order_id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mm, MIN(f.member_key) m
 FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
 WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' GROUP BY 1) f
 JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.web_order_id

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key, login_state,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS uncorrected_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) AS web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
